title: Output-style
description: Frontmatter schema for output-style definitions under src/apothem/output-styles/. The required floor is name + description, matching the mechanical floor the conformity grep enforces on every cohort file; id, applies-to, version, and last-reviewed are optional extensions.

id.description: Stable kebab-case identifier for the output style.

description.description: One- to two-sentence statement of the style's tone, format, and intended use.

applies-to.description: Artifact classes or contexts the style applies to.

version.description: SemVer version of the output-style definition.

last-reviewed.description: ISO 8601 date of last human review.

keep-coding-instructions.description: Claude Code key: true keeps Claude Code's built-in software engineering instructions (scoping changes, comments, verification) alongside the style. Claude Code defaults it to false, which drops them; every Apothem style sets true.
